import sys

def solve():
    T = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    for _ in range(T):
        S = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
        K = int(sys.stdin.readline())
        stack = []
        n = len(S)
        for i, char in enumerate(S):
            while stack and K - len(stack) > n - i - 1 and stack[-1] > char:
                stack.pop()
            if len(stack) < K:
                stack.append(char)
        print(''.join(stack))

solve()
